facts.text: Cheyenne is the county seat of Roger Mills County and has held that position since 1895.
The Washita Battlefield National Historic Site, located west of Cheyenne, marks where George Armstrong Custer's cavalry attacked a village in 1868.
Citizens of Cheyenne built the Cheyenne Short Line Railroad to ensure their town remained the county seat over a rival township.
Cheyenne benefited from the Panhandle-Hugoton field, the largest-volume gas field in the United States and the world's largest source of helium.
The Cheyenne High School girls six-on-six basketball team won three straight state titles from 1985 to 1987, including a 42-game winning streak.
Black Kettle National Grassland near Cheyenne offers opportunities for hunting, hiking, and wildlife watching.
